# rar-pdp-processor

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from plugins/rar-paz-plugin/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/rar-pdp-processor.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `rar-pdp-processor` component of `plugins/rar-paz-plugin`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar`: generated from its catalogue, [rar-pdp-processor.json](../../plugins/rar-paz-plugin/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/rar-pdp-processor.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_RAR_EXTRA_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PDP Dialect` (plugin field) | `governance-engine`; one of `governance-engine`, `authzen` | Which PDP the processor asks: the PingAuthorize governance engine, or an OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 PDP (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Anything but authzen, in any case, is the governance engine | Any | No |
| `PDP URL` (plugin field) | Unset; an http or https URL | The PDP's decision URL (for authzen, its /access/v1/evaluation); required, https unless OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development, and the console's https:// placeholder is refused (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Per request**: Blank, not a URL, or http outside development: the admin console and API refuse it on save; an archive import runs no validator, so the instance fails to configure and refuses every request that reaches it | Any | Yes |
| `PDP Domain Prefix` (plugin field) | `idpartners.authorization_details` | The governance-engine domain a detail is decided under, as <prefix>.<type>; the governance-engine dialect only. The default is the console's; a stored configuration without the field (from the admin API or an archive) reads as empty (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Read as given; a domain the PDP's policy does not know is denied | Any | No |
| `PDP Service` (plugin field) | `Authorization` | The governance-engine service named in each decision request; the governance-engine dialect only (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Read as given, blank meaning the default; a service the PDP does not know is denied | Any | No |
| `PDP Action` (plugin field) | `authorize` | The governance-engine action named in each decision request; the governance-engine dialect only (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Read as given, blank meaning the default; an action the PDP does not know is denied | Any | No |
| `Attribute Prefix` (plugin field) | `idp` | The prefix on the attribute names the processor sends the PDP. The default is the console's; a stored configuration without the field (from the admin API or an archive) reads as empty (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Read as given; empty, with Prefix Attributes with Type off, a requested field can reach a reserved name, and that request is refused | Any | No |
| `Prefix Attributes with Type` (plugin field) | `true` | Whether each attribute name also carries the detail's type; a stored configuration without the field reads as on (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false | Any | No |
| `Shared Secret Header` (plugin field) | `CLIENT-TOKEN` | The request header that carries the shared secret to the PDP (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Per request**: Blank: the default. A header the PDP does not read: it answers 401 or 403, and every request is denied, never failed open | Any | Yes |
| `Shared Secret` (plugin field) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The secret sent to the PDP in the shared-secret header; required, and stored encrypted under PingFederate's master key (a value an older jar stored in the clear still works until re-saved) (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Per request**: Wrong: the PDP answers 401 or 403, and every request is denied, never failed open | Any | Yes |
| `Types requiring an authenticated principal` (plugin field) | `payment_initiation,account_information`; a list | The detail types refused before any PDP call unless the decision is about a person PingFederate authenticated (principal_source none or client is refused); comma- or space-separated, and a single - means none (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Read as given; blank is the default, and - lets these types be decided about a client or nobody | Any | Yes |
| `Fail open on engine error` (plugin field) | `false` | Whether a request goes ahead without the PDP's narrowing when the PDP is unreachable (connection refused or reset, name unresolved, deadline, HTTP 429, 502, 503 or 504); any other answer, a malformed one and a TLS failure still deny, and the model's checks come first either way (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off | In production only as accepted risk `pdp-fail-open` | Yes |
| `Trust a client-asserted principal` (plugin field) | `false` | Whether login_hint or _principal_sub becomes the decision's subject when no principal is known, so the caller chooses who the decision is about; honoured only with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development, inert (with a WARNING at configure) elsewhere, and gone at 1.0 (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off | Not in production | Yes |
| `Trust the PAR-carried agent marker` (plugin field) | `false` | Whether, where the attestation is not in the request (the authorization endpoint), the agent instance comes from the _agent_id the attestation filter put in each entry at PAR; only for clients that must use PAR (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off | Any | Yes |
| `Skip TLS verification (dev only)` (plugin field) | `false` | Whether any PDP certificate is trusted; honoured only with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development, inert (with a WARNING at configure) elsewhere, and the JDK client checks the hostname either way (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: A checkbox: PingFederate stores true or false; missing reads as off | Not in production | Yes |
| `Request timeout (ms)` (plugin field) | `10000`; milliseconds, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | The PDP's connect and request deadline, in milliseconds; a request past it counts as the PDP being unreachable, so with Fail open on engine error on, a timeout shorter than the PDP's answer lets every request through without the PDP's narrowing (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.AttestationAwareRarProcessor, shown as "Attestation-aware RAR to PingAuthorize") | **Not checked**: Not a whole number, or 0 or less: 10000, without a word. Too short, with Fail open on engine error on: every request fails open | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_RAR_EXTRA_TYPES` (system property `oidf.rar.extra.types`, then env `OIDF_RAR_EXTRA_TYPES`) | Unset; a list | More authorization_details types PingFederate may bind to the processor, beyond sales_agent, payment_initiation and account_information, space- or comma-separated; read from the plugin descriptor at start-up, before any instance is configured, so not an instance field. A type needs a model too (rar-models): named here without one it is refused in production | **Not checked**: Read as given, comma- or space-separated; a type named here that no model names is refused (UNMODELLED_TYPE) on every request | Any | Yes |
